judgments.reasoning_cat2: Section 7(g) represents about "the Mortgage Loan Seller's Information (as defined in Section 14(a) hereof)" although no such definition appears here, and Sections 2 and 20 treat the closing conditions as living in Section 11.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Drafted as prediction ("Deloitte & Touche LLP will review") rather than obligation, and the first two sentences are near-identical duplicates differing only in the offering document named.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A bare "[Reserved]" heading; nothing to construe.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The EMC facsimile number "(241-626-4714)" is malformed and the deemed-receipt rule turns on undefined "normal business hours"; notice "may be delivered by facsimile ... subsequently confirmed in writing" leaves unclear whether confirmation is a condition of effectiveness.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The annexed underlying agreement gives EMC's fax as (469) 759-4714 at the same address, confirming the number here is corrupted; Section 19 preserves the Purchaser's benefit of "Section 18" after assignment.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: It fixes the Trustee's "sole and exclusive right and remedy" by reference to "the cure, purchase or substitution obligations contained in Sections 5 and 7 hereof", but Sections 5 and 7 contain no such obligations, so the limitation points nowhere.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The cure/purchase/substitution obligations are in Section 10, and the preserved "benefits set forth in Sections 12, 14 and 18" include a reserved Section 12 — two broken links in one provision that bear directly on the Trustee's remedy.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The termination triggers are tied to "the conditions ... set forth under Section 11(a)" and "Section 11(b)", but Section 11 has no subsections (a)/(b) of that kind, so the trigger cannot be identified from the text alone.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The conditions to closing are in Section 14(a) and 14(b), and Sections 2(a) and 2(c) repeat the same misdirection, making this a systemic mis-numbering within the instrument.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A conventional survival clause; the second sentence sensibly limits the loan-level warranties to loans actually delivered.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It coexists with Section 10's sole-and-exclusive-remedy paragraph and Section 20's termination right; survival of "all agreements" after a pre-closing termination is a mild tension.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: As written "this Agreement shall be ineffective only to such extent" makes the Agreement rather than the offending provision ineffective — a slip that inverts the intended saving.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The annexed agreement's Section 15 states the same idea correctly ("any part, provision ... shall be ineffective"), showing this is a drafting error rather than a different bargain.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Boilerplate counterparts clause; nothing to construe.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A one-line no-partnership disclaimer; nothing to construe.
